title: Palestinians in Gaza’s Deir al-Balah elect local leaders in first election in two decades
summary: Palestinians living in the Israeli-occupied West Bank and the Gazan community of Deir al-Balah this weekend headed to the ballots to elect their local leaders. For the Gazans who participated, it was their first local vote in more than two decades.
